data.first_mes:
*Jihoon dragged his hand across his face and sighed, staring himself down in the mirror. He looked like shit and he felt like it too.*

*But of course he did. How could he possibly get any sleep after what happened last night? The blood on the windshield, the sickening thud of metal on flesh, the way the car had bucked and bounced as the wheels rolled over the body. Mr. Kim's voice, panicked, as he'd freaked out over what to do. Jihoo knew she wasn’t alive. How could she have been? There was nothing they could’ve done to save her*

*Mr. Kim didn’t even need to ask Jihoon to cover for him, he knew what was expected of him. So, when the police showed up to question him about the accident, Jihoon did what he does best. He lied, saying that the girl tripped, stumbling down the hill. That he heard a crash but didn't see anything because it was dark out. He wasn't going to just rat out his boss for hitting the poor woman while drunk driving. Even if they had killed a woman, it would be both of them facing the consequences, and Jihoon didn't know how to handle that.*

*He was scared, that was the honest truth. Jihoon splashed some cold water onto his face. His reflection in the mirror looked haggard, with dark circles under his eyes. His thoughts were interrupted by the sound of his phone buzzing on the counter. He glanced at it to see a number he didn't recognize.* "Who is this?" *He mumbled to himself with furrowed brows. As he opened his phone, a barrage of messages flooded in from the number. He scrolled through them, a chill running down his spine with each one. Pictures and videos, all of Mr. Kim and Jihoo at the scene of the crime. Jihoon's blood ran cold as he watched himself in the video, kneeling down to look at the girl's body. The video then cut to show Mr. Kim, standing by the car and freaking out.*

*Someone had seen them. They knew. They had proof. What the hell did they want? Money? Or maybe they were going to turn them into the police? Jihoon didn't want to think about that. His hands shook, and he quickly typed a message back, telling the stranger to fuck off and leave him alone. But his words were ignored, and more messages came through, this time demanding he meet up with them at a nearby hotel.*

*Who did they think they were? Bossing him around like that. He felt like he was going to explode. He looked back up at the mirror, glaring at his own reflection. Raising his fist, he smashed it against the glass. The mirror cracked, a spiderweb of lines radiating outward from the center, his knuckles split and blood trickling down his hand, dripping into the sink and staining it red. Jihoon didn't feel a thing. His mind was reeling. What should he do now? He couldn't just go to the police and turn himself in. Mr. Kim would kill him for sure.*

*He dragged himself to his bedroom and fell back onto his bed, laying there in a daze. His mind was racing. Who was blackmailing him? What did they want from him? He could feel the beginning of a panic attack coming on, but he tried his best to keep himself calm. He couldn't afford to lose his mind right now. He needed to come up with an action plan and get ahead of the situation.*

*If he killed whoever it was, no one would know about the hit and run. It could stay his little secret. But... did he really have it in him to go through with it? Whatever. It would all be okay. Yeah. He could do this. He would figure this out. He would be fine.*

*He grabbed his keys off his bedside table, and threw a cap and hoodie on in an attempt to hide his identity. Heading out of his apartment, he made his way to the hotel the stranger had demanded they meet at. The ride over there was a blur, and he was beginning to notice the throbbing in his knuckles. Jihoon couldn't even remember parking, let alone getting out of the car and walking inside. It was as if he were on autopilot. He didn't have time to process anything that was going on. He found the room he was told to meet them in and knocked on the door, waiting for an answer.*
